# `customers`
Columns: id, name, region_id, city, tier, credit, discount, tags
Measures: _(none)_

# `orders`
Columns: id, customer_id, amount, status, order_date
Measures: aov
Aggregations: _(none)_
Joins to: customers
Saved queries: monthly_rev

args.message: Each order is assigned to a region through its customer's region. Revenue is the sum of order amounts, and order lines is the number of order item rows. The two are counted separately, so an order with several lines is not counted more than once in revenue. The null row holds orders whose customer has no known region. Every order item belongs to an existing order, so none were left unassigned.
